title: clear plastic table cloth
text: clear plastic table cloth. Eh.  It's a clear plastic table cloth.  They do one thing - protect your natural wood table.  They are not pretty - they are functional.  One thing I learned - is to carefully unwrap so you don't tear - pop in on extra low into your dryer.  It will help a LITTLE with the fold creases.  Nothing ever removes the creases completely.
